label: EXPERIMENTAL snowpack-structure prediction for expert decision support. Not an avalanche forecast, danger rating or operational guidance.
source: Avalanche Canada Mountain Information Network (public reports)

reports.title: Sunshine Meadows
reports.comment: quick: Skied in the backcountry near sunshine village where only Strawberry lift is open, there was wet snow to the top of Strawberry with light winds. We did a few laps on south aspect of Mt Standish.  Trail breaking was difficult as a new 10cm layer of wet heavy snow sat over a faceted midpack that you sank through especially in shallow areas.  We didn't observe the October crust that is prevale…

reports.title: Healy Pass (almost)
reports.comment:
weather: 1000: Day started with overcast skies, light to medium winds from the north and temps near -15 degC. S 1-2, lots of blowing snow. 

1230: skies cleared to scattered, sun was coming out. Precipitation stopped and calm winds. Temp was -12 

1430: few clouds, blue sky and sunlight during a transition. Calm winds and temps near the -12 degC. / snowpack: At 2100 m there was approximately 10-20…

reports.title: SSV meadows - Quartz 1
reports.comment: quick: Toured W aspect off of Standish and Up to Quartz 1 and down E face. Of interest was absence of any rain crust whatsoever - Oct crust was spotty at best. Rode down to maybe 35deg - no issues since there wasn’t any slab although winds had been reported as being quite strong this past week. Knee deep in facets and new precip today - really good snow although you had to watch out for rocks. Qui…

reports.title: Twin Cairns
reports.comment:
quick: Snow coverage at the Sunshine Village parking lot was just enough on Monday for our small party to skin up from and ski down to parking lot, that is, on the groomed ski-out.  It still seemed to be a bit "bushy" to ski a different route below treeline.  

Approaching the north end of Twin Cairns on ridge top, and generally at treeline and above, there was wind affected, slightly consolidated…

reports.title: Wawa Ridge
reports.comment:
quick: Fun laps of Wawa bowl. The snow was variable. Ski pen during skinning varied 0cm to 40cm and the skiing was equally variable. 

Dug a pit before the bowl, full results in the "Snowpack" tab. / weather: Broken clouds in the AM, and the snow arrived around 2pm as forecast. Mild westerly winds all day / snowpack: Snowpit. E-SE aspect. 2400m. Slope angle 32deg.

HS 110cm. 

CTV (SP) down 5cm. W…

reports.title: The alpine got hammered - SSV
reports.comment: quick: Skied the SSV meadows and made our way to check out the base of Citadel. No big surprise but the high winds in past days just hammered the snow pack. No significant obs - had some minor whumpfing on wind slab on low angle terrain so we dialed it back and didn’t bother with the alpine where wind effect was obvious. On the positive side, the recent wind means the snow pack is more supportive …

reports.title: Two Cairns Poke Around
reports.comment:
weather: clear to start the day then clpuds rolled in and started to get windier and light snow started in afternoon / snowpack: varible snow pack. obseserved wind scouring on windward side and windslabs at the ridge crests. lee side was deeper snow, depending how much wind got to it.

Sheltered areas seem to have the nicest snow

reports.title: Wawa Ridge
reports.comment: quick: CT- SP/Mod14

reports.title: Wawa
reports.comment: snowpack: Sudden planer 30cm down on a slight wind crust (new snow). continued CT but could not get a release on the Oct crust( Hard30) however there is facets below the Oct crust less than 10cm. Also Sunshine was bombing Wildest above the skirt and they got a full release that seemed to step down to ground. Sloughing above Borgeau left noticed on way down.

reports.title: Grizzly trees SSV
reports.comment: quick: Grizzly trees at SSV was in fine shape - you could feel the nov crust but no wind effect so amazing runs were had in knee deep snow. We traverses back via the base of trim cairns in the alpine and there was definitely more slab - and we had a number of collapses on the Nov crust (although we were on low angle). Didn’t feel like High in the alpine today here - but definitely considerable ...

reports.title: Healy Pass/ Egypt Lake
reports.comment: quick: Stable snow conditions, surface hoar observed in sheltered areas. Minor natural activity on steep lee slopes. / avalanche: Size 1 loose dry witnessed releasing from steep lee slopes.

reports.title: Grizzly Trees
reports.comment:
quick: Skied a lap of the fresh burn in Grizzly tree area, stable conditions throughout. No signs of instability. 
The day started sunny, clear and cold and ended in almost white out conditions. Wind increased throughout the day.

reports.title: Small Wind Slab on Bourgeau Left
reports.comment: quick: This is on the snow ledge between the second and third pitches. We were on rappel and took a more aggressive line down to avoid some potential ice fall from above but amazing to see what a 5-10’ change in angle can result in.

reports.title: Sphinx N and E faces
reports.comment: quick: Some shooting cracks observed in new storm snow soft slab on steeper slopes.  Turned back to ski less commuting terrain

reports.title: SSV and Healy are primed for action
reports.comment: quick: Easy to mod results in all tests on low angle 25’slope (Wawa hump) - including ECT21 SP down about 65cm on the Nov crust at 2350m on SE aspect. RB 2 down same with a 140lbs trigger. Counted at least 3 size 2.5+ on on SW face of Bourgeau. Size 2.5 in one of the Healy peaks near the pass on E aspect. Big V and Healy avi paths 1-2 haven’t slabbed off yet so even Healy trail will be suspect for…

reports.title: Avalanches - Bourgeau Right ice climb, Banff NP
reports.comment: avalanche: Two separate avalanches ran over the Bourgeau Right ice climb in the last couple days. A size 2 natural occurred during the storm and an explosive triggered size 3 occurred during avalanche control with a fracture line up to 2 m deep (see photos). This terrain is not often controlled but can be included when circumstances dictate that it makes sense. Bourgeau Left also had significant a…

reports.title: Healy Ridge Line - skiing SH diamonds in the alpine
reports.comment: quick: Put a track up from Healy creek up the ridge line to the top of Big V and subsequent Healy peaks (2 and 3). Some shear propagation in the alpine was observed on a few occasions without dislodging any slab (26 deg slope, NE face so lee to the recent storm snow). Some recent size 2’s observed in the alpine also. We worked terrain and never went over 30 degrees (although Big V was quite tempti…

reports.title: Bourgeau Left, Banff NP - Previous avalanche activity
reports.comment: avalanche: Photo outlining the approximate natural avalanche activity above the Bourgeau Left ice climb during the large storm ending on Dec 21, 2019.

reports.title: Healy Drainage/Gandalf? (one with the waterfall)
reports.comment: quick: Skied the Healy drainage with the waterfall at the end. Ski cut several convex rolls in the flat zone above the drainage (about 700m down from the ridge) with no result. The final one was very convex from about 15 to 35 degrees in about 3m. No cracks or movement despite a full ski cut and multiple jumps, did feel a slight settlement however from a harder layer of snow roughly 10-15cm down. …

reports.title: Sunshine village slackcountry
reports.comment: quick: Quick lap up the lookers right shoulder of twin cairns. We skied a mellow slope with thin trees. Snow wasn’t deep but still provided good riding. Coverage was great and we didn’t hit or see any rocks or fallen trees on the ride down.

reports.title: Repeater Slopes and Wawa Bowl
reports.comment: avalanche: Size 1, skier triggered skiers left Repeater Slopes. Size 2, remote triggered from lee pocket on Wawa Bowl.

reports.title: Below Twin Carins
reports.comment: avalanche: Remote trigger a short run (50m) slab of varying thickness (30-100cm) on very low angle convex roll (15-20’).  The crown ran around the side of hill (100+m).  Very low energy due to short length, not enough energy to break up blocks.  The slab was triggered after a very slight settling approximately 50-75 m away on very low angle ramp adjacent to the face that slid.

reports.title: Ridge Line Route above Healy Creek slidepaths
reports.comment: snowpack: ECTP15 down 48cm on SH 3.0-6.0 Dec 31. Surface Hoar appeared to be lying flat.

reports.title: Reactive SH in SSV slackcountry
reports.comment: quick: Reactive SH was found on various aspects as we toured SSV slack today. We easily triggered 1.5’s loose dry with dishwasher size cornice drops / although they mostly entrained the top 15cm of unconsolidated snow. Our out though was diff story / HS 145cm, got ECTP12 down 40 on the SH persistent layer. Also got RB2 on same layer. Made it more of an adventure to check out new terrain (including…

reports.title: Wawa ridge
reports.comment: quick: First mission in the sunshine area this season.  Up wawa ridge from the parking lot via ski out.  Dug a pit on small roll just beyond the backdoor entrance.  210cm deep, sudden failure 50cm down on perceived hoar frost layer while isolating the column.   Pounding on the remaining column, it eventually failed deep to facets.  Cautious against temption as this mid pack felt solid to ski with …

reports.title: Bourgeau Meadows, skier remote size 1
reports.comment: quick: Midpack is supportive and holding up well.  The skiing was pretty good on east aspects where when you are protected from the wind.   We were skiing a low angle bench and remote triggered a size one slab avalanche 30m below us on a convex role.  Slab thickness was 40cm, this layer was giving easy hand shears.  Lots of whumpfing in the meadows as well.

reports.title: Twin Cairns Glade
reports.comment:
quick: Had a quality day in Twin Cairn glades today.  Weather was overcast, no precip, light westerly wind and a pretty steady -5C all day. 

Dug a quick pit at approximately 2350m SE aspect, 25 degree roll-over just below tree line and found a surprisingly deep snowpack for this time of year. Measured HS of 175cm but probing showed it anywhere from 150 to 200cm! SSV official snow plot has it at …

reports.title: Healy Pass Area
reports.comment: quick: Good ski conditions in the healy pass area in general. Wumphing on low angle terrain. Stayed away from the steep stuff.

reports.title: SSV -Dinosaur Head and Healy creek area
reports.comment: quick: No significant obs to report - skied Dinosaur Head which is a steep but short chute at about TL and everything was supportive as far as the mid pack was concerned. Smashed some pillows around secondary drain with minimal sloughing. We did observe some recent reverse loading and even a small size 1 from maybe 2 days ago on the backside of Wawa hump which was weird. Skinned up towards Healy C…

reports.title: Small slide near Healy 1
reports.comment:
avalanche: Small slide cracked under the skier and slowly lumped down the slope a short ways. Convex roll on a open wind loaded slope. Wind had been howling for about an hour prior to the slide.

The photo is not of the avalanche, just of the general view/conditions. Photo is of Bourgeau, partly in the clouds. / weather: It was super windy.

reports.title: Tree Triangle
reports.comment: quick: Epic powder! Lots of loading over the last few days made for good skiing and some results on the new snow in a column test. / weather: Bit windy and snowing all day. Noticed a fair amount of cornices falling on the ridge near Giza Couloir. / snowpack: Failure at 4 hits on column test. Failed on storm snow. Solid mid pack with a few layers of concern.

reports.title: Bourgeau Lake
reports.comment: quick: Beautiful riding with some wind effect that was easily avoided. Very little snow in the Pass.

reports.title: Quartz Ridge/Rock Isle Lake
reports.comment: quick: Nice day in behind sunshine.  Visibility was terrible and it was snowing for most of the day.  Wind up on Quartz Ridge was quite strong and only made it about halfway up the ridge.  Had a nice ski down and then headed over towards Rock Isle Lake.  Skied a couple laps of a shoulder that led down to the lake.  Snow was amazing!

reports.title: Wawa Ridge (Sunshine)
reports.comment: quick: New weather system came in to bring in some new snow. Light to strong winds today, overcast with flat light, but still decent visibility most of the day. Ridges are hard packed, and rock exposed on west faces. Snow loading on east faces. Cornices on east faces are not overhanging, but getting big. Wawa gully had great snow today ~20cm deep where people haven’t been skiing. We left in a bliz…

reports.title: Monarch Ramparts
reports.comment: quick: Our group of 7 toured up to Healy Pass and then up the Ramparts for a few turns. It was snowing hard for most of our time in the alpine, as well as very windy. We skied open trees and alpine slopes to 35 degrees. No snow stability issues were noted.

reports.title: Pharaoh Peak
reports.comment: incident: Avalanche occurred 2020.02.23. SW aspect of Pharaoh Peak, Banff NP. Avalanche ran approx. 700m, Crown was approx. 150m wide, Depth was variable from 30-100 cm, bed-surface was mostly ground. Party of 4 was boot-packing to gain Pharaoh Peak ridge, crown broke near ridge top. Party was close together at time of incident but all members slid various lengths (100-450m), and all ended up on t…

reports.title: Egypt Lake Shelter
reports.comment: quick: Our party of 5 departed for Egypt Lake Shelter on March 6th from the Sunshine Village parking lot. It took us approximately 7 hours to get to our destination. After a long day of constant snow fall and low visibility we decided to stay in for the night instead of trying to find some slopes. On March 6th, our party headed for the Pharoah Lake trees where we found some decent tree skiing. Aft…

reports.title: Healy area and SSV
reports.comment: quick: Toured conservatively from SSV parking lot up the ski out. Snow Safety set up a gazillion signs with no uphill travel - so if you were thinking of skiing the Dive and West, better have a plan B. We ended up on top of repeater slopes (Wawa Ridge). Alpine was wind hammered with sastrugi and/or old wind slab/crust. Really crappy snow. Observed what looked like a size 2 from a natural cornice o…
